notes: Sentences Involving Compositional Knowledge: 9,840 sentence pairs built from image and video captions (Flickr8K, the SemEval-2012 video descriptions) by meaning-preserving and meaning-changing rewrites, each labelled for entailment (NEUTRAL / ENTAILMENT / CONTRADICTION, both directions) and relatedness (1-5); the official SemEval-2014 Task 1 split is a column (TRAIN 4,439 · TRIAL 495 · TEST 4,906), and each sentence keeps the caption it was derived from. The zip holds SICK.txt (tab-separated) and readme.txt.
